label: requireAccess()
type: the sync-function helper that rejects a document update unless the acting user already holds an explicit (non-wildcard) grant to at least one of the named channels. Recognizes only grants made by channel name, not by the all-channels wildcard - a user granted only '*' fails a requireAccess() check naming a specific channel.
note: Object is sgw:channel, via the requiresChannelAccess predicate promoted this round (see relations/requires-channel-access.json).
